newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian palm oil market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian palm oil market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Malaysian palm oil market is closed on Monday for a Hindu festival. It reopens on Tuesday.
On Friday, palm oil prices closed slightly lower after a very quiet pre-holiday session.

Third position January crude palm oil futures closed at 1,162 ringgit ($461.11) a tonne after trading in a eight ringgit range. Traders expect the contract to trade between 1,150 and 1,180 ringgit in the near term.
Volume on the futures market was 685 lots against 2,242 lots on Thursday.
